Rae (docs): quick thread — noticed a couple of small regressions in the rate-limits & metering docs: dashboard PNG shows old slab label, curl + python snippets missing account header, and pricing page still mentions 'floored' slabs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890
Marco (infra): thanks — panel id moved to `usage_metering_v2` last deploy. I'll export fresh images. export command: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering`
Tess (analytics): FYI legacy responses include `tier_key: "legacy"`. docs should show a one-line mapping or note. also the `quota_slab` display now rounds for UI only.
Rae (docs): plan: (1) swap images, (2) update snippets to include `X-Redwood-Account` header, (3) add migration note for `tier_key: legacy`, (4) add FAQ blurb: "Display rounding only; billing unchanged."
Omar (product): please add that sentence to the PR description to help support.
l10n-bot: queued: will run translations for updated files after merge (en -> fr, de, ja). ETA 48h.
Marco (infra): images exported and pushed to branch `docs/4890-metering-fixes`; stripped PNG metadata. updated sample query to new panel id.
Rae (docs): updating PR now with snippets + FAQ + screenshots. will request reviews once CI passes. :shipit:
